title: The Insurance Act, 1938
verified_how: Wayback CDX shows an India Code PDF at bitstream/123456789/2304/1/a1938-04.pdf, which matches India Code's naming convention for Act 4 of 1938. The archived PDF itself came back as an Akamai 403 page, and the LDH lookup was rate-limited, so the title and status were not read from the text.
notes: Principal insurance statute. s.45 limits repudiation of life policies, and claim settlement is governed through IRDAI regulations. Believed in force as amended (most recently by the Sabka Bima Sabki Raksha amendments), but not checked.
